headline: Union Cabinet To Table Amended Delimitation Bill In Parliament
seoTitle: Union Cabinet to Table Amended Delimitation Bill
metaDescription: The Indian Union Cabinet plans to introduce an amended delimitation and women's reservation bill during a reconvened session starting November 30.
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet is meeting to approve legislation focused on delimitation and women's reservations.
Parliament is expected to reconvene on November 30 to resume business following the adjournment of the Monsoon Session.
Previous attempts to pass the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill in the Lok Sabha did not achieve the necessary majority.
aiContextParagraph: The Indian government has scheduled a parliamentary session to begin on November 30, 2026, to address critical legislative business, including the proposed delimitation and women's reservation bills. This development follows over 100 days after the Monsoon Session was adjourned without a formal prorogation, allowing the current legislative session to resume rather than starting as a new special session. The Union Cabinet is scheduled to meet on November 27 to finalize the amended version of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill. This legislation previously failed to secure a sufficient majority in the Lok Sabha. Opposition parties have expressed concern regarding the government's approach to these high-priority issues as the legislative agenda for the upcoming session remains a significant point of political focus in the country.
whyItIsViral: The story is highly viral due to rapid coverage across four major news outlets and significant political interest regarding upcoming legislative changes.
